messages:
jia: Quick sync on Optimize toolkit delivery — small snag on quant recs + a regression alert. Eval E-492 shows ~4% ROUGE drop for summarization when switching to nf4. Putting owners/next steps here. @mo @alex PTAL.

mo: Saw the alert too. Infra logs show 95p latency spike on host-02 ~03:12 UTC and a KV-cache eviction burst. I can investigate infra side; assigning myself.

alex: I pushed a nf4-lite quant profile to staging yesterday but didn't run the full eval suite. If that's the cause we can revert. I'll start the eval run now. What's our canary window?

sarah: If we revert, I'd like to keep the batching improvements. Proposed batching config to try (staging):
```json
{
  "max_batch_tokens": 1024,
  "max_batch_requests": 16,
  "timeout_ms": 20
}
```
and KV cache TTL = 120s. In local perf, these cut cost ~8% without hurting p95.

carla: Linking the eval: https://internal/redwood/evals/E-492 — QA noted divergences on numeric tables and some tokenization edge cases. Could be rounding after quantization.

alex: Eval started, ETA ~30m. If we fail, plan is immediate rollback from staging -> canary. @deploy-bot can you schedule/confirm a canary window and auto-rollback thresholds?

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 1842057600 - 1842059400 (UTC). Automated rollback enabled for perf/regression thresholds: p95 latency +2x baseline OR ROUGE drop >2.5%.

mo: Infra notes: host-02 reported partial OOM (GC) ~03:11 UTC, which caused eviction cascade. I'll bump cache memory on that pool and add a guard so eviction spikes don't cascade. Monitoring alerted on eviction_rate > 1000/min.

sarah: Also propose we pin dedicated to model v2.1-nf4 for 24h after validation. Rollout owners: alex -> rollout/canary, sarah -> eval monitoring, mo -> infra, carla -> QA.

alex: I accept ownership. I'll open a PR with canary config + rollback playbook: https://git/repo/pr/789. @carla please attach failing prompt set to the PR so we can run targeted tests.

carla: Added reproducer examples and notes on tokenizer edge-case to the ticket and PR. Left a quick script for repro in pipeline: `scripts/repro_e492.sh`.

jia: Great — next steps recap: alex -> canary + PR, mo -> infra adjustments + guard, sarah -> eval/watch + metrics dashboard, carla -> reproducer + QA assertions. I'll follow up EOD with status and close the loop. :thumbsup:
